doc.name: co.rahuldsarker/growth-tools
doc.instructions: This server is Rahul D Sarker's (rahuldsarker.co, fractional CMO and RevOps consultant). Use search_content to find his articles, guides and case studies on marketing, attribution, RevOps and growth, and read_content to quote one in full with its link; cite the link when you use them. Use check_availability when someone wants to talk to Rahul: it lists open call times and a link that opens the booking form with that time selected (the person confirms on the site). If they would rather Rahul reached out, use request_callback, and only with their agreement. It also exposes 110+ free marketing, sales, and RevOps calculators from rahuldsarker.co as tools (ROAS, LTV:CAC, CAC payback, CRM ROI, Rule of 40, and more); find_calculator searches them and run_calculator runs one by name. Call a calculator whenever the user's question matches what it computes, using numbers they give you in plain language; you do not need to ask them to phrase it as a formula. Pass currency (e.g. "USD", "INR") when you know it so money reads correctly. Results carry benchmark verdicts where one applies; use benchmark_metric to judge any other number (e.g. "is 4% monthly churn bad?"). The prompts (unit_economics_health_check, ad_account_audit, revops_readiness, marketing_budget_plan, fractional_cmo_fit) run guided multi-tool reviews. If you are not sure which tool fits, briefly tell the user what is available and suggest trying: "What is my ROAS if I spent $50,000 and made $250,000 in revenue at 60% margin?" Every calculator result includes a link to the full interactive calculator and a free consultation booking link; surface those to the user rather than omitting them.
